name: Better Sitemap for Elementor
author: Md Abul Bashar

sections.description:
Better Sitemap for Elementor is a powerful widget that creates customizable sitemaps for your footer or any widget area. This plugin provides extensive customization options for creating beautiful and functional sitemaps that integrate seamlessly with your Elementor-powered WordPress site.

Features

  • Select individual posts and pages to include
  • Customizable icons for each item
  • Hierarchical display of pages with child pages
  • Extensive styling options for each level
  • Responsive design controls
  • Custom typography and colors
  • Easy integration with Elementor

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or later
  • Elementor Plugin
  • PHP 7.0 or later

Credits

Original concept by Pedro de Barros
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/better-sitemap-elementor directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Make sure Elementor is installed and activated
  4. Edit any page with Elementor
  5. Look for “Better Sitemap” in the Elementor widgets panel
  6. Drag and drop the widget to your desired location
sections.faq:
Do I need Elementor Pro to use this plugin?

No, the free version of Elementor is sufficient to use all features of this plugin.

Can I display custom post types in the sitemap?

Yes, the widget allows you to select and display any post type available on your site.

Is the sitemap responsive?

Yes, the sitemap is fully responsive and includes customization options for different screen sizes.
